title: NAPCC National Mission For Sustaining Himalayan Ecosystems
definition: NMSHE is one of the eight missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), specifically designed to evolve management measures for sustaining and safeguarding the Himalayan glacier and mountain ecosystem.
importanceInUpsc: The Himalayas are the 'Third Pole' and a climate-sensitive zone. UPSC frequently tests the intersection of climate change, biodiversity, and transboundary water security.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of NAPCC National Mission For Sustaining Himalayan Ecosystems.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
